findings.summary: __setstate__ assumes dict state, so old tuple-style pickles either raise TypeError or silently load with no attributes set; a tuple backward-compat branch is needed.
Module-level class A and single-case @pytest.mark.parametrize('cls', [A]) decorators are pointless; A could be used directly.
NEW_A is an all-caps class name that linters may flag, and mock.patch(f'{__name__}.A', NEW_A) relies on pickle's lookup by name without a explanatory comment.
Tests cover attribute added/removed but not loading an old tuple-format pickle.
